purpose: Attribute post-bind readiness changes without rewriting immutable release identity when deployment identity remains stable.

states.stable: Current readiness fingerprint matches bind-time fingerprint and deployment identity is stable.
states.operational-degradation: Readiness changed while deployment/source/artefact/publication identity remains stable.
states.identity-drift: Deployment or publication identity no longer matches the immutable binding.
states.not-bindable: No binding exists or current readiness is unknown/not-ready.
